name: stole-turntable
description: Builds ../../turntable.js (the 3D record player) from turntable.src.js and three.js.

scripts.build: esbuild turntable.src.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2020 --legal-comments=none --banner:js="// stole.cc 3D turntable. Built from tools/turntable/turntable.src.js with three.js (MIT, https://threejs.org). Rebuild: cd tools/turntable && npm install && npm run build" --outfile=../../turntable.js
